comments.overrides/flatted: Pinned to >=3.4.2 to resolve security advisory in transitive eslint > flat-cache > flatted dependency
comments.overrides/brace-expansion: Pinned to >=5.0.6 to resolve GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2 (CWE-400, CVSS 6.5, patched 5.0.6) in transitive dev dependency minimatch@10.2.4 > brace-expansion (was 5.0.5). Surgical override preferred over `npm audit fix`, which pulls 78 new platform-binary packages.
comments.overrides/@yarnpkg/parsers: Cycle 12 M D4-SA4.2-03 (D4): dev-only transitive js-yaml 3.14.2 (via lockfile-lint@5 > lockfile-lint-api@5.9.2 > @yarnpkg/parsers@3.0.3, which pins js-yaml ^3.x) carries GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68 / CVE-2026-53550 (moderate 5.3, quadratic-complexity DoS in YAML merge-key handling; fixed 3.15.0 and 4.2.0). The sibling lockfile-lint > cosmiconfig path already resolves js-yaml 4.2.0, so a scoped nested override is preferred over a global js-yaml pin: `"@yarnpkg/parsers": { "js-yaml": "^3.15.0" }` (3.15.0 satisfies @yarnpkg/parsers' existing ^3.x range). BLOCKED for a no-network audit SA exactly like dependencies/p-limit below: adding the override to `overrides` without regenerating package-lock.json desyncs the manifest and every `npm ci` (build + supply-chain jobs) fails closed on the sync check. Follow-up (one networked commit): add the nested override above, run `npm install` to land package.json + the regenerated lockfile together, then re-run `npm run mcp:cve-check`-adjacent gates. Companion low: esbuild GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (resolves 0.27.3; Windows-only dev-server arbitrary file read, CVSS 2.5) takes >=0.28.1 via the next tsup/tsx/vitest dependabot group merge — 0.28.1 is out-of-range for tsup's esbuild ^0.27.0 (needs a tsup release) but in-range for vite ^0.27.0 || ^0.28.0, and tsx already carries its own fixed nested esbuild 0.28.1; not force-overridden here to avoid breaking the tsup build API.
comments.dependencies/p-limit: Prod-dependency pinning policy (D4-SA4.2-06, Cycle 12): exact-pin every prod dependency — the house supply-chain posture (pin what executes; lockfile + surgical overrides + SHA-pinned Actions encode the same philosophy). 10 of 11 prod deps are exact-pinned; p-limit is the lone caret (^7.3.0) and the sole known exception to the policy. The Cycle-10 currency bump (D4-SA4.2-F4.2.5, commit 088d9fc) has LANDED — p-limit now resolves to 7.3.0 (package-lock.json node_modules/p-limit); the residual p-limit 3.1.0 in the lockfile is the dev-only p-locate > p-limit@^3.0.2 transitive, unrelated to the root spec. Aligning the root spec ^7.3.0 -> 7.3.0 to close the exception is BLOCKED for a no-network audit SA exactly like the override entries above: editing the spec alone desyncs package-lock.json (its root-dependency mirror, packages[''].dependencies, still reads ^7.3.0), and `release.yml` 'Verify lockfile sync' (git diff --exit-code package-lock.json) plus every `npm ci` integrity check fail closed on a spec-only or hand-edited lockfile. Follow-up (one networked commit): set p-limit to 7.3.0 and run `npm install` to land package.json + the regenerated lockfile together; the three pLimit call sites (src/workspace/sync.ts, src/workspace/manifest.ts, src/pipeline/complianceVerification.ts) use the stable default-export pLimit(concurrency) signature and are unaffected by the range-style change.
comments.devDependencies/@types/update-notifier: Held at ^6.0.8 (D4-SA4.2-09, Cycle 12): 6.0.8 is the latest real DefinitelyTyped release — no 7.x @types exists (`npm view @types/update-notifier versions` tops out at 6.0.8; the 1000.0.x-alpha entries are DefinitelyTyped non-matching stubs, not v7 types; re-verified 2026-07-12), while the runtime update-notifier is 7.3.1 and ships no bundled declarations (no *.d.ts, no types/typings field). The used API surface (src/cli/program.ts, src/cli/shared/updateNotifier.ts) type-checks clean against the v6 declarations, so this is awareness only — no bump target exists. Re-check when @types/update-notifier publishes 7.x or update-notifier bundles its own types; durable fix is upstream bundled types or a local module declaration if a v7 API-shape delta ever mis-describes a call site.
comments.scripts/lockfile:check: Cycle 12 H D4-SA4.2-02 (D4): the second lockfile-lint invocation guards website/package-lock.json (the Docusaurus site's lockfile, previously outside every dependency gate). It omits --validate-package-names because Docusaurus legitimately aliases transitive packages (react-helmet-async -> @slorber/react-helmet-async, react-loadable -> @docusaurus/react-loadable), which that flag flags as a name mismatch; --validate-https + --validate-integrity + --allowed-hosts npm still apply.
